values.title: Securing SSH with FIDO2: Hardware Keys for Git Signing and Remote Access
values.description: SSH keys can be stolen from disk. Replace them with hardware-bound FIDO2 credentials that physically cannot leave the device.
values.prerequisite: Comfortable with SSH key management and git on the command line. No prior FIDO2 experience needed.
values.image_alt: A hardware-backed SSH connection between a developer laptop and server
